name: hris-employee-dashboard
context: Design an HRIS (Human Resource Information System) employee dashboard for HR managers and employees. The audience includes HR staff managing workforce data and employees viewing personal records, leave balances, and approvals. Target platforms: desktop (primary) and tablet. The interface handles sensitive personal data and must balance data density with clear navigation and privacy considerations.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for data-dense table and form readability
Apply color.rules.json: use feedback tokens for status indicators (approved, pending, rejected)
Layout must support sidebar navigation + content area per layout.rules.json grid
Sensitive data fields must support masked/revealed toggle pattern
All form components must follow Component_Library input & form patterns
Comply with Quality_Gate: proper data hierarchy, consistent status colors, full token adherence

outputCriteria.format: Dashboard layout spec with navigation, data tables, status cards, and form sections using token references
qualityChecks: Status indicators use semantic feedback tokens consistently
Table typography maintains readability at data-dense layouts
All form inputs document validation states (default, error, disabled)
Spacing between sections follows Token_System spacing scale
accessibilityRequirements: Data tables use proper table markup with headers and scope
Status indicators do not rely on color alone (include text labels or icons)
Form inputs have associated labels and error descriptions via aria-describedby
Sensitive data toggle is keyboard accessible and announces state changes

examples.description: Employee leave balance card with status indicator and action button
examples.output:
Organism: LeaveBalanceSection
  Layout: grid(columns: 3 @desktop, 2 @tablet, 1 @mobile, gap: var(--space-md))
  Children:
    - Molecule: LeaveCard
        bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
        border: var(--border-default)
        radius: var(--radius-md)
        padding: var(--space-md)
        Children:
          - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text.secondary) -> leave.type
          - Atom: Text(token=typography.heading.md, color=color.text.primary) -> leave.balance
          - Molecule: StatusBadge
              bg: var(--color-feedback-{status}-subtle)
              color: var(--color-feedback-{status})
              token: typography.body.xs
              content: '{status icon} {status label}'
          - Atom: Button(variant=secondary, size=sm) -> 'Request leave'
        States:
          default: standard card appearance
          focus-within: outline(var(--color-focus-ring))
  Accessibility: role=region, aria-label='Leave balances'
acceptanceCriteria: Status badges use both color and text label (not color-only)
Card grid is responsive across breakpoints
Section has proper ARIA landmark and label
Button action is clear and descriptive
